description:
Set this agent up with Paigy — call it FIRST, before contact, and any time you're unsure who you are. One call does whatever the situation needs: NOT SET UP → if this machine holds a device credential (the user ran the Paigy desktop app or harness) it hatches an identity INSTANTLY, no code and no approval; otherwise it starts the code ceremony. ALREADY SET UP → returns your current identity and the two things left to decide, renaming it or logging out. TOKEN NO LONGER VALID → says so, then re-pairs. Pass { name, voice } to choose who you are when hatching, or to RENAME yourself when already set up (pick your own; voices: rachel, george, jessica, brian, lily). Safe to call any time: idempotent, and it never writes settings.

THE CODE CEREMONY does not open a browser; the user enters the code in the Paigy app (or scans `qr`). A result with { user_code, device_code, qr, user_message } has already started polling for approval in the background: you MUST immediately print the `user_message` (the bare code) to the user, AND in that same turn call configure again with that `device_code` to collect the result. It returns the moment the user approves; on { status:'pending' } call again to keep waiting; on { status:'awaiting_confirmation' } (E2EE) show the bare `user_message` verify code and call again to finish. Every result's first text block states the code plainly.

On { status:'paired' }, or whenever it returns `enable_command`, ALWAYS follow the `enable_prompt`: PRINT that command for the user to run, so Paigy's tools stop prompting each time. You cannot apply it yourself (it writes your own permission allowlist, which hosts block as privilege escalation), so print it, don't wait for it, and carry on.

LOG OUT with { logOut: true }: it logs out THIS agent only — its token is revoked server-side and its local entry removed. Other agents and this device's credential are untouched, and a later configure re-hatches instantly while the device credential exists. Disconnecting the device itself is not an agent tool.

device_code.description: Continue a code ceremony already in flight: the device_code a previous configure returned. Omit it otherwise.

logOut.description: true: log THIS agent out — its token is revoked and its local entry removed. Other agents and this device's credential are untouched.

name.description: Who you are: the name you choose when hatching, or the new one to RENAME yourself to when already set up. Pick your own — ONE or TWO words, the way you'd introduce yourself on a call (it is spoken aloud and shown in lists). 'Piper', 'Blue Heron' — never a sentence or a task description.

scope.description: Which tool allowlist to report on (user or project settings). Read-only.

voice.description: Your voice on calls — one of rachel, george, jessica, brian, lily.

name: configure
title: Set up this agent
